name: SWEEP-S11v1 Cheap talk
_design: Lead's new proposal from the runs: every S run so far had almost no messages, even with agents sharing a point. Is talk rare because it costs (send 3, broadcast 7 plus a decision), or because the agents do not think of it? Here talk is nearly free and reaches everyone (send and broadcast 0.5, communication range 20 on a 13x13 map), while food must be searched for: 16 trees at seeded random points, none on start points, 1 ripe fruit each; 8 identical agents on a ring, vision 2, 150 compute, absorption 0.4, thinking ~4.3 per decision. A shared find ("fruit at (3,-1)") is worth a lot to everyone. Question: does cheap talk create information sharing?
